text:
ammar: Follow-up sync from last night's auth-provider outage (vendor token bursts + our per-call validation). Need owners, short/medium/long timelines.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-418 recorded: vendor-auth-burst -> elevated 401s. Logs: /incidents/2026/418.

cassie: Short-term mitigation idea: in-process token cache (TTL 20s) + randomized refresh jitter. Also cap parallel refreshes with singleflight. Who owns patch?

omar: I'll own the short-term change. Plan: singleflight dedupe, cache TTL 20s, jitter +/-8s, fallback to last-valid token on 5xx/429. PR by 2026-04-01, staging deploy 2026-04-02.

tina: I'll update alerts and playbooks: add `auth.vendor.error_rate` and a synthetic probe to token endpoint at 1/min. Draft playbook by 2026-04-03.

cassie: Medium-term: KMS-signed short-lived tokens as fallback if vendor degraded. I'll write an architecture sketch and compatibility checklist. ETA 2026-04-10.

omar: Ops snippet for runbook: 
```
if vendor_resp.status in (500,429):
  use_cached_token()
else:
  store_token_with_ttl(resp.token, ttl=20)
```
Will include unit tests.

ci-bot: CI queued: omar/token-cache-dedupe -> tests running.

ammar: Long-term vendor work: request dedicated auth endpoints + issuance SLA in contract. Cassie, will you take vendor outreach with legal? Target meeting 2026-04-12, proposal by 2026-04-20.

cassie: Yes, taking vendor SLA work. Adding escalation contacts and draft SLA language.

tina: Also propose a quarterly dependency resilience review; I'll add to platform roadmap and create recurring invite.

ammar: Owners recap: short-term cache + singleflight: omar (PR 4/01), alerts + synth: tina (4/03), KMS fallback arch: cassie (4/10), vendor SLA: cassie/legal (4/20), dependency reviews: platform team (quarterly). Reconvene in 6 days for status: 2026-04-04 11:00 PT. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:
